name: Macau
summary_text: Macau: own legal system: decriminalised since 1995, no protection legislation, government anti-discrimination bills repeatedly shelved; conservative business-and-church climate. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: China (0.40) plus a local delta of +0.10. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Thai transgender YouTuber alleges sexist treatment at Chinese airport | Thaiger
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This article is about a Thai trans YouTuber's treatment at a mainland Chinese airport, not Macau; included as regional context.
NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying NYT investigation covers transgender 'conversion' practices in China - regional context for Macau (a Chinese SAR).

Macau Daily Times (Feb 2015): Rainbow of Macau met Identification Bureau officials to discuss changing gender on Macau ID documents - one individual ('Avery', speaking behind a screen) sought the change; the first organised push for gender recognition in Macau.

sources.title: Mr Gay World cancels Hong Kong event citing concerns over LGBTQ crackdown in mainland | Hong Kong Free Press HKFP
sources.claim_summary: Hong Kong Free Press (Aug 2018): Mr Gay World cancelled its Hong Kong event citing concerns about the LGBTQ crackdown on the mainland - regional context affecting Hong Kong/Macau LGBT events.

Macau Daily Times (May 2016): Rainbow of Macau criticised the government for excluding same-sex relationships from domestic-violence legislation because same-sex partners were not considered 'family members'.

Jason Chao / Rainbow of Macau statement (May 2016): the government knowingly enacted a discriminatory domestic-violence law despite the UN Committee against Torture's 2015 concluding observations requiring protection without discrimination; warns the law signals that sexual-orientation discrimination is justifiable.
